name: Bauernhof Großpointerhof & Haus Haselberger
beschreibung: The Großpointerhof and Haus Haselberger are located on the edge of Ebbs, a village in Unterland near the German border. The accommodations are offered as holiday apartments, complemented by an inn with traditional cuisine. Guests can expect a rural atmosphere with views of the surrounding meadows and the Kaisergebirgszug. The farm is home to animals that invite you to gain experience. Breakfast is offered freshly prepared.
